title: Manager, Global Procurement Solutions
description:
Job Description JOB DESCRIPTION Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) Global Procurement Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Page 3 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Required Functional Skills & Expertise Technology Procurement Strategic Sourcing Contracting Negotiation SaaS, software licensing, cloud, telecom, managed services, IT professional services, and global technology suppliers Category strategy, RFx/eSourcing, supplier evaluation, spend analysis, market intelligence, TCO, cost modelling, and award recommendations SAP Ariba Sourcing and Contracts; SAP S/4 or ECC, Coupa or equivalent; ServiceNow; Excel; Power BI preferred SaaS agreements, vendor redlines, SOWs, change requests, contract lifecycle management, renewals, and commercial risk assessment Structured negotiation planning, leverage creation, stakeholder alignment, supplier negotiation, and measurable value delivery Governance Tools & Systems Procurement policies, approval thresholds, compliance controls, audit readiness, and source-to-pay governance Soft / Power Skills Strategic Thinking: Translate business needs into practical sourcing and commercial strategies. Leadership Without Authority: Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies. Negotiation Excellence: Apply a structured, fact-based approach to complex technology negotiations. Analytical Problem-Solving: Use data, cost models, and market insights to guide decisions. Executive Communication: Explain complex procurement strategies and contract positions clearly. Stakeholder Management: Build trust and effectively manage senior global stakeholders. Change Mindset: Challenge the status quo and drive process and technology improvements. Resilience & Agility: Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and global time-zone requirements. Page 4 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing. 5-7 years of direct IT Procurement experience across SaaS, software, cloud, telecom, managed services, or IT professional services. Demonstrated experience negotiating SaaS agreements and reviewing supplier redlines in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders. Proven technology negotiation experience, with the ability to explain the situation, strategy, tactics, stakeholder alignment, and commercial outcome. Experience working with global suppliers and stakeholders across multiple geographies, primarily North America and Europe. Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred. Professional procurement certification such as CPSM, CIPS, ISM, or equivalent is preferred. Willingness and flexibility to work North America-aligned hours / night shifts. title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) position is a software development-oriented role, focusing heavily on coding, automation, and ensuring the stability and reliability of our global platform. The ideal candidate will primarily be a skilled software developer capable of participating in on-call rotations. The SRE team develops sophisticated telemetry and automation tools, proactively monitoring platform health and executing automated corrective actions. As guardians of the production environment, the SRE team leverages advanced telemetry to anticipate and mitigate issues, ensuring continuous platform stability. What Will You Be Involved With Develop and maintain advanced telemetry and automation tools for monitoring and managing global platform health. Actively participate in on-call rotations, swiftly diagnosing and resolving system issues and escalations from the customer support team (this is not a customer-facing role). Implement automated solutions for incident response, system optimization, and reliability improvement. Proactively identify potential system stability risks and implement preventive measures. What Will You Bring to the Table 
Software Development:
 3+ years of professional Python development experience. Strong grasp of Python object-oriented programming concepts and inheritance. Experience developing multi-threaded Python applications. 2+ years of experience using Terraform, with proficiency in creating modules and submodules from scratch. Proficiency or willingness to learn Golang. 
Operating Systems:
 Experience with Linux operating systems. Strong understanding of monitoring critical system health parameters. 
Cloud:
 3+ years of hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, EKS, ELB, RDS, DynamoDB, and SQS. AWS Associate-level certification or higher preferred. 
Networking:
 Basic understanding of network protocols: TCP/IP DNS HTTP Load balancing concepts 
Additional Qualifications (Preferred):
 Familiarity with trading systems and low-latency environments is advantageous but not required. What We Bring to the Table Compensation: 
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.
 Health & Financial Security: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage Group Life (GTL) and Group Income Protection (GIP) schemes Pension contributions Time Off & Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. One dedicated day per year for volunteering. Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. An additional PTO day added during milestone anniversary years. Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). Work-Life Support & Resources: Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. Milestone anniversary bonuses. Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives (including discounted healthcare premiums, healthy meal delivery programs, or smoking cessation support). Our Culture: Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

The TT platform delivers advanced tools for trade execution and order management, market data solutions, analytics, trade surveillance, risk management, and infrastructure services to the world s leading sell-side institutions, buy-side firms, and exchanges. The company s blue-chip client base includes Tier 1 banks as well as brokers, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers.
